prose.subject: Invoice INV-91052: Monthly Logistics Services
prose.body:
Dear Corvane Labs Team,

Please find attached our monthly invoice INV-91052 for the logistics services rendered in the current billing period. The total amount due is 1598.93 USDC.

Breakdown of charges:
- Standard Freight (42 pallets): 1200.00 USDC
- Fuel Surcharge: 150.00 USDC
- Customs Clearance Fee: 180.93 USDC
- Handling & Storage: 68.00 USDC

Payment is due within 30 days. Please remit the full amount to our designated account:

quillonlogistics93.testnet

We appreciate your continued partnership. Should you have any questions regarding these line items, please do not hesitate to reach out to our billing department.

Best regards,
Quillon Logistics
